jobs.title: Animal Care Manager
jobs.description:
The Beluga Operating Company ehf is seeking an animal care manager.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.

At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.


This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.


As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.

Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.


You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.

You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.

Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.

Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.

If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.

jobs.title: Sustainability & Utility Manager to BAT Fiedler & Lundgren
jobs.description:
About the role

As Sustainability & Utility Manager to BAT Fiedler & Lundgren, you will play a leading role in ensuring a safe working environment, driving the factory’s sustainability agenda, and securing reliable and efficient utility operations. The position has a strong focus on health and safety (EHS), where you take overall responsibility for compliance with Swedish legislation, internal standards, and international requirements, while continuously improving ways of working and strengthening the local safety culture.

You will work closely with the production teams, ensuring that EHS processes, risk assessments, incident reporting, chemical handling, energy mapping, and sustainability data are accurate, up to date, and effectively implemented. The role also includes responsibility for utility management, where you set the direction for maintenance, manage and follow up on contracts, and act as a technical expert in projects involving EHS, sustainability, or utility.

A central part of the role is to drive improvement initiatives and support cross-functional collaboration. You lead the EHS and sustainability roadmap, coordinate audits and inspections together with authorities and external partners, and contribute to the development of sustainable and efficient production processes. You will lead a team of six and foster a high-performing, engaged, and collaborative work environment. The role includes OPEX responsibility and close interaction with regional sustainability and engineering teams, as well as suppliers and service providers.

This is a full-time consultancy assignment for six months with the ambition for a permanent hire. The position is based in Malmö and is primarily on-site during daytime hours. Occasional and infrequent travel within Europe may be required. Preferred start date is as soon as possible.

About you

You are a confident and experienced leader with a solid background in EHS and sustainability, ideally gained in an industrial or manufacturing environment. You bring at least five years of experience from production settings and have previously led teams. Your understanding of Swedish EHS, environmental, and utility legislation is strong, and you have the ability to translate this into practical, efficient processes that support safe and sustainable operations.

You thrive in a role where both structure and analytical thinking are crucial. You are comfortable working with energy balances, water balances, and technical data, and you can assess, calculate, and challenge information when needed. As a communicator, you are clear, engaging, and able to build strong relationships across all levels of the organization. You combine a proactive “can-do” mindset with the ability to coach, influence, and implement improvements.

Important for the role:

    Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience from industrial or manufacturing operations
    Leadership experience within a production or industrial environment
    University degree in EHS, Sustainability or a related field
    Strong knowledge of Swedish legislation within EHS, sustainability and utility
    Solid knowledge of how an industrial production company operates
    High proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint
    Ability to drive change, lead improvements and develop teams
    Able to review (project) plans/designs regarding sustainability aspects and identifying discrepancies
    Fluency in English
    Good knowledge of Swedish and previous experience from the food industry are considered advantageous for the role.

Contact details

If you have questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter: Maja Svensson at maja.svensson@adecco.se

If you have questions regarding registration, please contact our support at info@adecco.se

We are looking for a gastric surgeon to fill a full-time position at a hospital in Møre og Romsdal.

The hospital is part of a dynamic healthcare organization in Western Norway. The surgical department includes several senior positions and is supported by a multidisciplinary team providing high-quality care. The department handles a wide range of surgical cases and is committed to continuous professional development and innovation.

Responsibilities:

    Perform advanced surgical interventions for gastric and bowel-related diseases and traumas, including cholecystectomies, hernia repairs (both open and laparoscopic), colectomies and ostomies, hemorrhoidectomies, fundoplication and other surgeries related to the gastric system.
    Provide outpatient and inpatient care in collaboration with the surgical and multidisciplinary teams.
    Participate in on-call duties within the department.
    Supervise and mentor resident doctors and medical students.
    Contribute to the development of the department’s surgical practices and protocols.

Qualifications:

    Authorization to practice as a medical doctor within the EU.
    EU certification as a general surgeon with specialization in gastric surgery.
    Experience in gastric and bowel surgeries, including trauma management.
    Proficiency in English and motivation to learn Norwegian, supported by our free language course.

Personal attributes:

    Strong professional engagement and surgical expertise.
    Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
    A structured and independent work style.
    Positive and flexible attitude with a commitment to a collaborative work environment.

The hospital offers:

    Competitive salary in accordance with national agreements.
    Attractive pension and insurance schemes.
    A stimulating and supportive work environment with opportunities for professional growth.
    Access to research opportunities and professional development programs.

About the location:

The hospital is situated in Møre og Romsdal, in a vibrant and growing city known for its cultural richness, excellent educational facilities and modern amenities. This urban hub is surrounded by the region’s renowned natural beauty, including fjords, mountains and coastal scenery. Residents enjoy year-round outdoor activities such as hiking, skiing and fishing, while the city itself offers a lively atmosphere with restaurants, cafes and cultural events. Strong transport connections make it easily accessible, creating an ideal balance between urban living and proximity to nature.

Benefits through Dignus Medical:

    Ongoing support from a dedicated personal advisor before, during, and after employment.
    Assistance with obtaining Norwegian medical authorization and any necessary specialist approvals.
    Support with accommodation and travel arrangements, including family relocation.
    Access to a free Norwegian language course with a private tutor online.

If you are looking for a fulfilling position in one of Norway’s most beautiful regions, we look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: OBGYN Consultant opportunities at University Hospitals in Ireland
jobs.description:
Would you like a role with broad clinical exposure within both obstetrics and gynecology while gaining experience in an English-speaking healthcare system?

On behalf of university hospitals and established specialist environments in Ireland, we are recruiting OBGYN consultant for 6-12 month positions, with the possibility of extension.

This opportunity is well suited for specialists who would like to work broadly across both obstetrics and gynecology while gaining experience from modern hospital environments with high clinical activity and close multidisciplinary collaboration.

We are particularly interested in candidates with strong experience in general obstetrics and gynecology as well as broad surgical competence within gynecological procedures. For several of the positions, a minimum of three years of experience at consultant level is preferred.

Please note that you must hold medical authorisation and specialist certification from an EU/EEA country to be eligible for these roles.

About the position

As an OBGYN consultant, you will work with the assessment, treatment and follow-up of patients within both obstetrics and gynecology. The role combines outpatient care, surgical activity, inpatient management and assessment of acute presentations.

The positions involve close collaboration with midwives, anesthesiology staff, nurses and other medical specialties. Several of the hospitals are university-affiliated and have active specialist environments within research, teaching and clinical development.

Typical responsibilities

    Management and follow-up of pregnant and laboring patients
    Assessment and treatment of gynecological conditions
    Gynecological surgery and operative procedures
    Outpatient clinics and day surgery
    Evaluation and management of acute obstetric and gynecological presentations
    Participation in multidisciplinary collaboration and coordination of patient pathways
    Supervision and mentoring of resident doctors and other healthcare professionals
    Contributing to quality improvement, patient safety, and clinical development
    Participation in on-call duties where applicable

Surgical expertise and clinical areas

We are looking for candidates with broad gynecological surgical expertise, including:

    Total abdominal hysterectomy (TAH)
    Vaginal hysterectomy
    Pelvic floor and prolapse surgery
    Diagnostic and operative laparoscopy
    Operative hysteroscopy
    Outpatient gynecological procedures and ambulatory gynecology services

Experience in the following areas is also highly desirable:

    Transvaginal ultrasound for endometrial assessment
    Diagnostic hysteroscopy
    Operative hysteroscopy using MyoSure and TCRF resectoscope
    Colposcopy, preferably with BSCCP accreditation

We are looking for someone who

    Is a specialist in obstetrics and gynecology
    Holds EU/EEA medical authorization and specialist certification
    Has broad experience within general obstetrics and gynecology
    Has strong surgical experience in gynecological procedures
    Has experience providing ambulatory gynecology services
    Has excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken
    Thrives in an international and multidisciplinary working environment
    Maintains high professional standards with strong focus on quality and patient safety

We offer

    Contract for 6-12 months, with the possibility of extension
    The opportunity to gain international experience in an English-speaking healthcare system
    Positions at established university hospitals and specialist environments within OBGYN
    Close follow-up and guidance throughout the entire recruitment process
    Assistance with registration, interviews and relocation
    The opportunity for a short visit to Ireland, ideally together with your partner or family, to get to know the hospital and the area before making a decision

Salary

Base salary depending on experience, typically around €233,000–€280,000 gross per year.

Why Ireland?

Working in Ireland gives you the opportunity to practice medicine in an English-speaking healthcare system while gaining valuable international experience. You will work in a collaborative clinical environment with modern facilities and a strong focus on patient care.

Beyond work, Ireland offers a high quality of life and a welcoming atmosphere. The country is known for its dramatic coastline, green landscapes and charming towns. Ireland also has a lively social culture, where local pubs often serve as gathering places for music, conversation and community.

Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the opportunities, possible locations and the next steps in the process. Feel free to contact us for an informal conversation.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
Why do you want this new job
jobs.description:
No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â

In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far:

  • Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years.
  • Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance.
  • Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss.
  • Iâm looking for more challenging work.

All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills

Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills.

About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer.

If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job.

About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job.

Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it.

In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. As long as you are able to justify why you want the new job, theyâll be quite accommodating.

Who You Are

You are a proactive procurement professional with strong leadership capabilities and a passion for driving operational excellence. You thrive in an international environment and are able to balance stakeholder expectations with business priorities.

To be successful in this role, you have:

jobs.title: Massør søges til fast fuldtidsstilling på Frederiksberg – maks. 30 timer om ugen - Massage therapist wanted for a full-time position in Copenhagen/Frederiksberg.
jobs.description:
English version below – please scroll down.

Brænder du for at gøre en mærkbar forskel for mennesker gennem massage?

Massage Experterne har travlt, og vi søger derfor to dygtige og engagerede massører, som vil være en del af vores klinik på Frederiksberg.

Hos os får du ordnede ansættelsesforhold, en solid fast grundløn kombineret med behandlerløn og en arbejdsuge, der er tilrettelagt med respekt for, at massage er fysisk krævende. Derfor er fuldtid hos os maksimalt 30 timer om ugen.

Samtidig får du en travl hverdag med mange klienter, gode kolleger og mulighed for løbende faglig udvikling.

Om jobbet

Du kommer primært til at behandle private klienter i vores klinik på Frederiksberg. Derudover samarbejder vi med en række virksomheder, hvor vi tilbyder firmamassage.

Behandlingerne består hovedsageligt af fysiurgisk og dybdegående massage med fokus på blandt andet:

  • Muskelspændinger og smerter

  • Nakke-, skulder- og rygproblemer

  • Sportsskader og overbelastning

  • Stressrelaterede spændinger

  • Øget bevægelighed og velvære

Du får en fast base i klinikken, og der kan desuden være enkelte vagter med firmamassage.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast fuldtidsstilling på maksimalt 30 timer om ugen

  • En solid fast grundløn kombineret med behandlerløn

  • Ansættelseskontrakt og ordnede forhold

  • En travl og veldrevet klinik med mange klienter

  • Økonomisk tryghed og stabile arbejdsforhold

  • Løbende sparring med dygtige og erfarne kolleger

  • Workshops, kurser og mulighed for faglig udvikling

  • Sociale arrangementer og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på både kvalitet, resultater og trivsel

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er uddannet massør eller fysioterapeut

  • Har erfaring med fysiurgisk eller dybdegående massage

  • Kan levere behandlinger på et højt fagligt niveau

  • Er professionel, imødekommende og god til klientkontakt

  • Er mødestabil og kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Taler dansk eller engelsk på et godt niveau

Det er en fordel, hvis du er RAB-registreret, men det er ikke et krav. Har du færre uddannelsestimer, men stærke praktiske kompetencer og relevant erfaring, hører vi også meget gerne fra dig.

Hvem er vi?

Massage Experterne er en professionel massageklinik med fokus på kvalitet, grundighed og resultater.

Vores klienter kommer blandt andet med muskelspændinger, sportsskader, smerter og stressrelaterede gener. Vi lægger vægt på et roligt og tillidsfuldt behandlingsmiljø, hvor klienterne føler sig i trygge og kompetente hænder.

Som behandler bliver du en del af et sammentømret team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og prioriterer både faglig udvikling og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til:

job@massageexperterne.dk

Fortæl kort om din uddannelse, din erfaring med massage og hvorfor du gerne vil være en del af Massage Experterne. Ansøgningen behøver ikke være lang.

Du kan læse mere om jobbet og om os her:

www.massageexperterne.dk/massage-job

Vi læser ansøgninger løbende og kontakter relevante kandidater hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Massage Therapist Wanted for a Permanent Full-Time Position in Frederiksberg – Maximum 30 Hours per Week

Are you passionate about making a real difference in people’s lives through massage?

Massage Experterne is a busy clinic, and we are currently looking for two skilled and dedicated massage therapists to join our team in Frederiksberg.

We offer proper employment conditions, a solid fixed base salary plus treatment-based pay, and a working week designed with an understanding of how physically demanding massage therapy can be. For this reason, a full-time position with us consists of no more than 30 hours per week.

You will enjoy a busy working environment with plenty of clients, supportive colleagues and opportunities for continuous professional development.

About the Position

You will primarily treat private clients at our clinic in Frederiksberg. We also work with several companies where we provide on-site corporate massage.

Treatments mainly consist of therapeutic and deep-tissue massage, focusing on areas such as:

  • Muscle tension and pain

  • Neck, shoulder and back problems

  • Sports injuries and overuse injuries

  • Stress-related tension

  • Improved mobility and well-being

The clinic will be your permanent base, although the position may also include occasional corporate massage shifts.

What We Offer

  • A permanent full-time position of no more than 30 hours per week

  • A solid fixed base salary plus treatment-based pay

  • An employment contract and proper working conditions

  • A busy, well-run clinic with plenty of clients

  • Financial security and stable employment

  • Ongoing professional support from skilled and experienced colleagues

  • Workshops, courses and opportunities for professional development

  • Social events and a strong sense of teamwork

  • A workplace focused on quality, results and employee well-being

Who We Are Looking For

  • You are a qualified massage therapist or physiotherapist

  • You have experience with therapeutic or deep-tissue massage

  • You are able to provide treatments to a high professional standard

  • You are professional, welcoming and comfortable communicating with clients

  • You are reliable and able to work independently and in a structured manner

  • You speak either Danish or English to a good standard

It is an advantage if you have completed at least 250 hours of massage training or are RAB registered, but this is not a requirement. If you have completed fewer training hours but possess strong practical skills and relevant experience, we would still be very pleased to hear from you.

Who Are We?

Massage Experterne is a professional massage clinic focused on quality, thoroughness and results.

Our clients visit us with issues including muscle tension, sports injuries, pain and stress-related discomfort. We prioritise creating a calm and trusting treatment environment where clients feel safe and in capable hands.

As a therapist, you will become part of a close-knit team where we support one another and prioritise both professional development and a positive working environment.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

Please send your CV and a short application to:

job@massageexperterne.dk

Tell us briefly about your qualifications, your experience with massage and why you would like to become part of Massage Experterne. Your application does not need to be long.

You can learn more about the position and our clinic here:

www.massageexperterne.dk/massage-job

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will contact suitable candidates as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager | Össur
jobs.description:
Would you like to make a meaningful impact, by helping healthcare professionals improve patient outcomes through innovative mobility solutions—and ultimately helping people live a Life Without Limitations® ?

We are seeking an experienced, driven and results-oriented Area Sales Manager to join our Ossur Nordics Bracing & Support Sales team, covering Stockholm and northern Sweden. Working as part of a Bracing & Support team, and reporting to the Sales Director Nordics, you will be responsible for sales performance and business development across Sweden.

Your role

You will be responsible for sales and growth of existing and new products in the bracing & support segment for your territory. You will grow existing accounts, identify new opportunities and build or maintain trusted partnerships with customers and key stakeholders. Working closely with your Sales Director as well as colleagues across Sales, Clinical, Marketing, Customer Care and the wider Nordics organisation, you will develop and execute sales plans that support regional objectives, strengthen our market position and ultimately achieve ambitious sales goals and deliver sustainable growth.

On a day to day basis, you will develop, build and cultivate relationships with existing and new customers by initiating contact with various decision makers, physicians, clinic staff, and other device users in order to expand Össur’s customer base and further strengthen the market position and brand recognition. Areas of responsibility will include:

    Executes sales strategies, in line with overall objectives
    Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders including hospitals, clinics, physiotherapists, and distributors
    Provide product training and support to healthcare professionals
    Manages time effectively to ensure optimal customer contact, both face-to-face and virtually
    Monitor market trends, competitor activity and analyze sales figures and react accordingly
    Identify and approach high potential customers, seeking out opportunities for business growth
    Collaborate with marketing and product teams to support promotional activities
    Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and sales performance in Salesforce

Who you are

We are looking for an ambitious, confident and commercially minded sales professional who is motivated by meeting customers and creating results, which in this position is more important than a deep medical insight. The will and potential to learn is what counts! A true team player, both eager and open to learn from colleagues and share your experiences in return to ensure not only individual success, but that of the whole team.

    Relevant sales or account management experience, with a track record of achieving or exceeding targets
    Experience in managing a geographical territory and developing new business
    Knowledge in sales methods and techniques, with a good understanding of customer and market dynamics and requirements
    Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and confidence using sales data to guide decision
    Excellent written and spoken Swedish and strong working English
    Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
    Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned area
    Valid driving license
    Experience within medical devices, orthopaedics, rehabilitation, healthcare or a related sector is meritorious. Understanding of bracing and support products, and their clinical applications is also meritorious

What we offer

This role is a unique opportunity to join a dedicated team at a company positioned for continued growth. You will also work in an innovative, flexible and international environment together with committed colleagues who all work towards the same goal - improving people’s mobility!

Össur’s values are Honesty, Frugality and Courage. Our core competencies include Collaboration, Communication, Driving Results, Customer Focus and Change.

The employment

Full-time, 6 months probationary period, start according to agreement. Remote, location Stockholm. Travels 75% in Sweden is required.

jobs.title: Firefighting Service Engineer; Location DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced service engineer with a background in offshore operations and hands-on knowledge of firefighting systems? At Semco Maritime, we keep critical safety systems running on some of the world's most demanding offshore installations — and we're looking for someone who takes pride in doing that well.

Your position
As a Firefighting Service Engineer in our Technology Solutions division, you will join a close-knit Service Team based at our Global HQ in Esbjerg, Denmark. Your work will directly support the safety and reliability of offshore energy operations worldwide — from routine maintenance to complex troubleshooting in the field.

This is a full-time position with significant international travel (100+ days per year). If you thrive in a varied, hands-on role where no two weeks look the same, this could be a strong fit.

”This is a great opportunity to work worldwide with high performance fire protection systems, take on complex challenges and build valuable experience in a specialised engineering field” – Nikolaj Søegaard, Manager, Service Firefighting

Your tasks & responsibilities
You will be responsible for the delivery, coordination, and execution of firefighting service and maintenance across our on- and offshore client base. Day-to-day, this includes:
  • Servicing, troubleshooting, and supervising firefighting systems (Water Mist, Deluge, Foam, Argonite, and others)
  • Planning and executing maintenance and installation work onshore and offshore
  • Preparing and reviewing work packages, including Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS)
  • Providing remote technical support and contributing to tenders and quotations
  • Building client relationships and identifying service opportunities
  • Upholding health, safety, and environmental standards in all activities

Your profile & qualifications
We're looking for someone who is technically solid, safety-conscious, and comfortable working independently in demanding environments. You likely have:
  • A technical qualification in engineering or a related discipline (mechanical and/or electrical)
  • 1–5 years of experience in the offshore industry
  • Hands-on knowledge of firefighting systems in an operational setting
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with clients
  • Relevant offshore certifications (e.g. BOSIET/OPITO) — or willingness to obtain them
  • Experience with work package preparation and safety documentation (RAMS)
  • The ability and willingness to travel 100+ days per year and work offshore

What we offer
You will be joining a high-performing, international team where safety culture is genuinely lived, not just stated. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, and your base will be at our Esbjerg HQ — on the waterfront, at the heart of the Danish energy industry. As Semco Maritime continues to expand our service capabilities, there are real opportunities to grow with us.

Welcome to Semco Maritime
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.description:
Kom med på holdet hos en spændende produktionsvirksomhed i Gandrup! Der er travlt og brug for dig!

For vores samarbejdspartner i Gandrup søger Randstad en alsidig produktionsmedarbejder til en rolle både på lageret men også skiftevis i produktionen fungerende på et fast skiftehold dag og aften. Det kræves at du har truckcertifikat og har hænderne skruet ordentlig på. Stor fordel hvis du har noget kendskab og interesse i mekanik.

Om stillingen
Du vil indgå i et team, hvor I løser opgaverne i fællesskab hvor du vil få en grundig sidemandsoplæring. I starten vil dine primære opgaver være truckkørsel, og efterfølgende vil du skiftevis hjælpe i produktionen. På lageret får du ansvaret for at køre paller med færdigvarer væk fra båndet samt laste og losse lastbiler.

På sigt får du et større ansvar i produktionen når der er et hul i vagtplanen. Her skal du være med til at holde maskinerne kørende – særligt ved mindre nedbrud – samt sørge for, at pallerne lægges korrekt på færdigbåndet. Derudover vil der være diverse forefaldende opgaver som oprydning og rengøring.

Skifteholdet er fra uge til uge:
- Daghold fra 06.00-14.00 5 dage om ugen man-fre
- Aftenhold fra 13.50-20.30 5 dage om ugen man-fre

Om dig
For at bestride stillingen skal du have truckcertifikat og være klar til at gribe de udfordringer, der opstår. Du har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og kan bruge værktøj - samt har lyst til at arbejde med både lager og produktion.

Der er tale om en alsidig og lidt atypisk stilling. Du kommer måske fra en lignende stilling som maskinoperatør og har mod på også at arbejde på lageret – eller også har du en baggrund inden for landbrug, entreprenørfaget eller lignende. Uddannelse ikke nødvendig, det er mere den rette person vi leder efter.

Arbejdsopgaverne er:
• Køre med truck på lageret
• Læsse og losse biler med paller
• Betjening og overvågning af anlæg i produktionen
• Kvalitetssikring af emner til færdigvarebånd

Vi forventer:
• Frihed under ansvar kendetegner stillingen og virksomheden.
• Du har en god fysik, gåpåmod og vilje til at lære.
• Du er ansvarlig og mødestabil.
• Du er selvkørende og selvstændig, men kan arbejde i teams.
• Du taler og forstår dansk.

Vi tilbyder:
• Overenskomstmæssige forhold
• Konkurrencedygtig lønramme
• Fast stilling efter endt Try and Hire forløb
• Arbejdstøj og sikkerhedssko

Ansøg
Hvis du synes, at ovenstående lyder spændende, og hvis du har lyst til at arbejde i en produktion, ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV. Tryk på knappen "Ansøg nu" for at sende dit CV. Såfremt du ønsker at vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte konsulent Asmus Dam på 48808201 - Vi afholder løbende samtaler, og alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

Om randstad
Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

jobs.title: Engineering Support Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description

To support and maintain the Kindred Racing Platform (KRP) and Kindred Sports Platform (KSP) through debugging and analysis, and to assist global stakeholders in minimising downtime during incidents.

Main Duties / Responsibilities

    As an Engineering Support Analyst, you will be responsible for identifying and resolving issues within various components of critical business systems. Your role will involve providing dynamic service and acting as a software detective to ensure the smooth functioning of systems. This includes triaging bugs, escalating tickets with comprehensive information, responding to alerts, and initiating On-Call when necessary, all while maintaining clear and effective communication.
    Working alongside stakeholders including Traders, Developers, DevOps, and SRE teams.
    Provide technical support for critical business systems, ensuring timely identification and resolution of issues.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain seamless system functionality.
    Conduct root cause analysis to identify and address underlying issues and implement preventive measures to avoid future occurrences.
    Demonstrate a solid understanding of software engineering principles and practices.
    Collaborate / Handover with colleagues in Bangalore and Australia (IST & AEDT).

Key Accountabilities / Measures

    Provide comprehensive support for global stakeholders.
    Drive issues to resolution efficiently and effectively.
    Monitor and utilise alerts to promptly address incidents.
    Enhance reliability by pushing capabilities forward and innovating for continuous improvement.



Preferred Experience and Knowledge  

    2-3 years of proven experience in providing technical support for critical business systems.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    Excellent verbal and written communication skills, essential for working with global stakeholders.
    Extensive knowledge of support principles, including incident and problem management.
    Desirable knowledge in server stack and website support.
    Extensive experience in issue debugging, analysis, and resolution.
    Required experience and understanding of the following toolsets:
    Experience
    Elastic / Grafana / Splunk
    Prometheus / Loki / Tempo
    Understanding
    Kubernetes/Docker
    Linux / Windows
    Solace / Kafka
    Postgres
    Experience in creating Grafana dashboards, integrating metrics, logs, and traces to provide a proactive approach to error detection.
    Testing experience is a definite advantage.



Essential Educational and/or Training Qualifications & Certificates  

    A tertiary qualification in an Information Technology-related discipline is highly desirable.

Vi søger stabile og servicemindede taxachauffører, som sætter kunden i centrum og leverer en god oplevelse på hver eneste tur.

Der køres gennem kørselskontoret DRIVR, som også har adgang til ture via Uber.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. About 1000 clinics in more than 40 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe and Asia - Pacific. Today we are more than 400 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

Are you an experienced Product Designer who enjoys solving complex problems together with experts from different fields? At RaySearch, you’ll help transform advanced clinical needs into thoughtful, impactful software used in cancer treatment worldwide

About the role

Designing for oncology software means working in a demanding but meaningful domain. You'll make confident, well-reasoned design decisions that uphold safety, accessibility, and risk management standards, working alongside clinical specialists, physicists, and developers advancing cancer care.

As a Product Designer at RaySearch, you'll translate complex clinical needs into precise, user-centered interfaces designed with empathy. Working across product teams, you'll design role-specific workflows, evolve our design system, and ensure every detail holds up in the real world.

This is a hands-on role focused on implementation, quality, and impact. You'll design flows and UI components, collaborate closely with developers, and validate your work through usability testing. You're expected to take initiative, follow through, and continuously improve the way we design, from Figma to code prototypes to the experience in the clinic.

You'll join a UX team of designers and clinical specialists who design treatment systems used by clinicians worldwide, software that holds up when it matters most.

What you’ll do

    Design detailed user flows and high-fidelity UIs for complex clinical systems.
    Create and refine components based on our design system, adapted to real workflows.
    Prototype and test concepts early, ensuring they are intuitive, accessible, and safe.
    Collaborate with developers, product managers, and clinicians to deliver production-ready solutions.
    Take ownership of your work and have the ability to balance multiple constraints in complex design decisions.

Your profile

We are looking for an experienced Product Designer who can navigate complex stakeholder landscapes and collaborate effectively with subject matter experts across a wide range of disciplines. In this role, you will work closely with professionals from software engineering, medical physics, and clinical domains, bridging different perspectives to create user-centered solutions in a highly specialized environment. You are structured, proactive, and take ownership of initiatives, driving the design process forward while aligning user needs, technical possibilities, and business goals. Further, we would like you to have:

    A relevant academic background in Product Design, Interaction Design, UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
    5+ years designing complex products, with a portfolio of shipped work.
    Skilled in Figma and AI prototyping tools.
    Strong knowledge of building and maintaining design systems.
    Comfortable in regulated, complex environments, healthcare, medtech, or similar.
    It is meritorious if you have direct experience designing for oncology, radiology, or clinical decision support.

Our Culture

Culture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems, no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.

Our Offer

At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

Application

Please apply to the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications by e-mail. Selection and interviews will be ongoing.

jobs.title: Start Your International Career as a Gourmet Butcher – Earn a Salary Throughout Your Apprenticeship - Greater Copenhagen, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you a young EU citizen dreaming of a career in food craftsmanship?

This apprenticeship is open to EU citizens who have the right to live and work in Denmark.

At Born & Kolstrup in Rødovre, Denmark, you will receive a paid apprenticeship, an internationally recognised vocational qualification, and the opportunity to become part of one of Denmark's strongest butcher teams. We are proud winners of the Danish Butcher Award 2025 and are looking for a motivated apprentice who wants to develop in a profession built on quality, craftsmanship and teamwork – in a workplace with an informal management style, employee involvement and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

Read more about the award:
https://goderaavarer.dk/aktuelt/nyheder/2025/se-hvem-der-vandt-slagterprisen-2025/
What does a Gourmet Butcher do?
A Danish Gourmet Butcher does not slaughter animals. Instead, the profession focuses on preparing, cutting and refining high-quality meat products and delicacies.
During your apprenticeship, you will learn to:
  • Cut and prepare premium meat products.
  • Produce charcuterie, delicacies, convenience foods and ready meals.
  • Develop new recipes and food products.
  • Work with food safety and quality control.
  • Plan production and work closely with experienced colleagues.

After completing your apprenticeship, you will receive a Danish Journeyman's Certificate, a respected vocational qualification recognised both in Denmark and internationally.
What can you expect from your apprenticeship?
We offer:
  • A paid apprenticeship throughout your education.
  • A thorough introduction and structured training programme.
  • Assistance with finding accommodation, obtaining a CPR number and settling into life in Denmark.
  • A safe workplace with a strong focus on employee well-being.
  • Friendly and experienced colleagues who will support you from day one.
  • An informal working environment with employee involvement.
  • Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • A healthy work-life balance with time for friends and leisure activities.

Several of our employees have worked abroad themselves and understand what it is like to start a new life in another country.
We are looking for someone who:
  • Is an EU citizen with the right to live and work in Denmark.
  • Has a passion for food, quality and craftsmanship.
  • Is ambitious and eager to become highly skilled.
  • Has completed compulsory education or an equivalent qualification.
  • Can communicate in English.
  • Is willing to learn Danish and become part of Danish culture.
  • Enjoys teamwork and takes responsibility.

Salary and employment conditions
The apprenticeship lasts 3½ years, and you will receive a salary throughout the entire programme.
Monthly salary (collective agreement between DSM and the Danish Food Workers' Union, NNF):
Apprenticeship Year Salary (DKK) Approx. EUR
1st year per month 13.708 1.835
2nd year per month 17.343 2.321
Remaining apprenticeship per month 20.490 2.743

  • Working hours: 160.33 hours per month
  • Employer-paid pension contribution of 12.6% after three months of employment.
  • Salary is paid in Danish Kroner (DKK).

Your education
Your practical training will take place at Born & Kolstrup, located in Rødovre Centrum, just 8 km from Copenhagen City Hall Square.
The school-based training will take place at ZBC in Roskilde, Denmark's largest vocational college.
Ready to take the next step?
Would you like to build an international career with an award-winning company and become a skilled food craftsman in Denmark?

jobs.title: IT-Ansvarig - LÖFAB
jobs.description:
Lövstjärnan Fabriks AB (LöFAB) is a Swedish defence manufacturing company established to support Nordic and NATO security-of-supply requirements through manufacturing, co-production, and lifecycle sustainment through partnerships and sub-contracts with global OEMs. LöFAB provides an EU-based industrial solution that enables compliant production, long-term support, and scalable capacity within Europe.

Vill du vara med och bygga upp och utveckla IT-funktionen i ett växande företag?

Trivs du i en bred roll där du kombinerar support, IT-säkerhet och verksamhetsutveckling samtidigt som du får stort eget ansvar? Då kan detta vara rätt möjlighet för dig.

Lövstjärnan Fabriks AB är ett bolag i stark utveckling där teknik, innovation och långsiktigt tänkande är viktiga delar av verksamheten. I takt med vår tillväxt söker vi nu en IT-ansvarig som vill ta en nyckelroll i att utveckla och säkerställa en modern, säker och effektiv IT-miljö.

Om rollenSom IT-ansvarig har du det övergripande ansvaret för den dagliga IT-driften och fungerar som företagets naturliga kontaktperson inom IT. Du arbetar brett med support, system, användarhantering, leverantörskontakter och IT-säkerhet samtidigt som du bidrar till att utveckla verksamhetens digitala arbetssätt.

Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med hela organisationen där du säkerställer att medarbetarna har rätt verktyg, system och support för att kunna arbeta effektivt. Du blir också delaktig i förbättringsprojekt och digitala initiativ som stärker verksamheten inför framtiden.

Din profilVi söker dig som har en bred IT-bakgrund och erfarenhet av såväl användarsupport som systemadministration och IT-säkerhet. Du har god förståelse för Microsoft 365, moderna IT-miljöer och behörighetshantering. Erfarenhet av informationssäkerhet och arbete med strukturerade säkerhetsramverk är meriterande.

Som person är du serviceinriktad, självgående och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs med att ta ansvar, har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och uppskattar att arbeta nära verksamheten där du får kombinera teknik med människor.

Vi erbjuderEn attraktiv tjänst i ett växande bolag där du får stort inflytande över utvecklingen av företagets IT-miljö. Du blir en del av en entreprenöriell verksamhet med korta beslutsvägar, högt engagemang och goda möjligheter att påverka. Här får du chansen att växa tillsammans med företaget och ta en nyckelroll i vår fortsatta utveckling.

Ansökan

Vill du vara med på Lövstjärnan Fabriks resa? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig. Urval sker löpande.

Säkerhetsprövning kommer att ske innan anställning. Godkänd säkerhetsprövning krävs för anställning.

I denna rekrytering samarbetar Lövstjärnan med FSK Group.

Om FSK

Vi är FSK, The Generator – ett bolag som driver utveckling och tillväxt genom våra tre affärsområden:

Talent – Vi hjälper framåtlutade företag att hitta rätt människor, främst inom Management, Specialists, Sales och Marketing.

Brand – Vi stärker varumärken genom Employer Branding och Business Branding.

Growth – Vi skapar inspirerande och utmanande utbildningar som utvecklar företag för framtiden.

jobs.title: Sales Jedi
jobs.description:
Great salary | Profit share | 100% remote |
Work from anywhere in Europe | SaaS

 

Awesome opportunity for a self-motivated and energetic people person to join our remote team and help sell our world-leading SaaS products, from anywhere in Europe.

We pay a great salary, based on experience and location. We don’t pay commissions, because good sales are a team effort—from engineering, to operations, marketing, and support, our high-performing team all contribute to a great product and service that our clients love. Everybody in the company is rewarded with a share of profit each December—we succeed together.

Our much-loved products are in demand and are proven to make a difference to our clients’ lives. You’ll be selling world-leading software through a well-considered process that leaves room for personal flair.

 

SaaS experience is extremely beneficial but strong communication skills, patience, curiosity, keenness to learn and friendliness are key to success in this role.

Join our Rebel Alliance

Creative Force is experiencing strong growth and as we scale our efforts in 2026 and beyond, we’re looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our diverse team of Jedis to help recruit new clients as they navigate the decision process, and transform them into long-term supporters.

You’ll be a respected member of our remote global sales team and will be well supported with the tools, knowledge and answers you need to provide exceptional levels of service, and to make the most from solid sales traction with our two in-demand products.

As you master the Force and the multitude of skills needed in this role, attracting clients to join our mission, you will be recognised and rewarded with strong career and salary progression.

Responsibilities

 

  • Help prospects find the specific value they seek (this is the product you are looking for)
  • Collaborate with our diverse international team to push us on the leading edge of our fields
  • Learn to be a product expert and confidently answer product questions from prospects
  • Discover how to be an expert in SaaS for recognition programs
  • Master our sales technology stack
  • Support the complete sales cycle, from qualified lead to close
  • Skillfully navigate consultative sales discussions and live demos

Essentials

 

  • Applications are open to all experience levels, with a minimum of 1 year proven success in SaaS sales or a similar role
  • Must live in Europe
  • Digital native, with enthusiasm for technology
  • Discipline and self-motivation (key to success in remote work)
  • Loads of energy, humour, passion, and empathy
  • Genuine interest to help provide amazing value for people
  • Superior communication skills
  • Commitment to continuous improvement
  • You have access to fast, reliable internet and a dedicated space to work without distractions
  • Meet and exceed measurable performance goals to succeed and progress in this role

What we offer

Work-life balance

  • 38 hour work week, Monday to Friday (your weekends are yours)
  • 20 days paid annual leave
  • 20 days paid parental leave (available after one year)
  • 12 days paid public holidays (your local country/region public holidays)
  • Your birthday is a holiday every year

Personal development and wellbeing

  • Commitment to continued learning and development
  • A culture of promoting work life balance
  • Access to mental health support

Location and compensation

  • Full-time role, based remotely, work anywhere within Europe
  • No commission structure. Competitive salary, indexed to your experience and location
  • Budget for computer and office equipment (pending 6 month probationary period)

 

Respect, growth and stability

  • Friendly, sociable, responsible, collaborative team (a great place to be)
  • Respect for each other’s time, value and contribution
  • Regular communication with global team via chat and video calls
  • Dynamic, young, growing tech company leveraging all the latest tech tools and leading industry trends
  • Stable, bootstrapped, independent business (no VCs calling the shots)

jobs.title: Myyjiä Eepeen Kaupan henkilöstöpooliin
jobs.description:
Primary location:
SEINÄJOKI

Myyjiä Eepeen Kaupan henkilöstöpooliin
Haemme myyjiä henkilöstöpooliin, ihan tavallisiin töihin - poikkeuksellisen monipuolisiin työtehtäviin!

Avoinna olevat myyjän työtehtävät ovat vakituisia, osa-aikaisin työtunnein, keskimäärin 12-24h/vko.Toivomme, että voit aloittaa työt mahdollisimman pian. Alussa on kattava ja käytännönläheinen perehdytysjakso, jonka aikana marketin toimintatavat tulevat tutuiksi.
Haemme tekijöitä laajasti poolin eri toimialueille rannikon, Suupohjan, Härmänmaan sekä Seinäjoen ja lähikuntien alueille. Henkilöstöpoolissa työskentely on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa – yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen! Pooli on tosi tykätty, joustava ja monipuolinen työskentelymalli, jossa työntekijät pääsevät työskentelemään joustavasti useissa Eepeen market - toimipaikoissa. Henkilöstöpoolilaisena sinulle kasvaa monipuolinen osaaminen marketin työtehtävistä. Poolin tavoitteena on helpottaa yksiköiden arkea, tuoden apua ja osaamista sinne, missä sitä eniten tarvitaan.


Työ kaupan henkilöstöpoolissa on myyjän työtä, kuten hyllytystä, asiakaspalvelua ja kassatyötä. Poolilainen on todellinen arjen moniosaaja ja osaamisen lähettiläs, joka vie hyviä käytäntöjä toimipaikasta toiseen. Hän pääsee auttamaan toimipaikkoja, joilla on äkillinen tarve saada huippu työkaveri avuksi. Poolilaisella on useampi työnteon yksikkö, ja hän saa aluksi kattavan perehdytyksen marketin työtehtäviin. Meillä työskennellään yhdessä tiimin kanssa, joten toivomme sinulta hyviä yhteistyötaitoja. Työ edellyttää oman auton käyttöä ja liikkumista alueen henkilöstöpoolin yksiköissä.

Odotamme sinulta:Täysi-ikäisyyttä

Mahdollisuutta liikkua poolin toiminta-alueen yksiköissä

Valmiutta työskennellä monipuolisessa vuorotyössä, myös juhlapyhinä ja viikonloppuisin

Suomen kielen taitoa asiakaspalvelutilanteissa

Myyjän työ on tänä päivänä yhä digitaalisempaa, ja siksi odotamme sinulta toimeen tarttuvaa ja sujuvaa otetta järjestelmiin ja myymälän tietoteknisiin työvälineisiin.

Aikaisempi kokemus kaupanalan tehtävistä on hyödyksi, mutta positiivinen asenne ja aito halu oppia ja tehdä asiakaspalvelutyötä ovat kaikkein tärkeintä menestyäksesi tehtävässä

Koko henkilöstöämme koskeva tulospalkkiojärjestelmä

Kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunnan, kulttuurin ja hyvinvoinnin Epassi-edut

Poikkeuksellisen paljon erilaisia mahdollisuuksia!

Pitkä hakuaika mahdollistaa hakemisen aina syyskuulle saakka – käsittelemme kuitenkin hakemuksia ja teemme valintoja jo hakuaikana, joten hae mukaan viipymättä!

jobs.title: Rustfri Smed
jobs.description:
Rustfri smed

 

Er du erfaren indenfor rustfri svejsning ? Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være udlært smed – det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring og kan levere et godt stykke håndværk, og er en kompetent og alsidig håndværker, som har fokus på kvalitet. Vil du gerne indgå som et ansvarligt medlem af et team i en professionelt ledet virksomhed? Så er du måske én af vores nye medarbejdere.

 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Svejsning og bearbejdning af emner i rustfrit stål

  • Arbejde ud fra tegninger og arbejdsbeskrivelser

  • Kontrol af kvaliteten på de færdige emner

  • Samarbejde med kolleger om at få opgaverne sikkert og effektivt gennem produktionen

Har du også erfaring med aluminium, er det en fordel – men det er ikke et krav.

 

IQ Metal er i vækst, og for at møde vores kunders forventninger om leveringsfleksibilitet og -sikkerhed, har vi besluttet at øge antallet af medarbejdere og investere i en række nye maskiner. Du vil blive en del af et team med mere end 450 medarbejdere i IQ Metal, som samarbejder med store kunder i hele Europa. Vi leverer typisk samlede løsninger af produkter og fokuserer på at give kunderne den bedste oplevelse ved at sikre komplet levering til tiden, i rette kvalitet.

Kan du se dig selv i virksomheden?

Du indgår som en fast del af et godt team med 10-15 mand, som selv planlægger hverdagen og skaber overblik over ordreplanen. Vores maskinpark sikrer, at alt kører som det skal. En del af vores maskiner er fuldautomatiske, mens andre er semi-automatiske. Vi inviterer gerne på en kop kaffe og tur rundt i produktionen, hvis du er interesseret i et job hos os.

Vi tilbyder:

Løn og ansættelsesforhold er gode og konkurrencedygtige, og indeholder udover pension også en sundhedssikring. Alle fastansatte på nathold tilbydes årligt sundhedstjek. Der er kaffe og vand tilgængeligt i kantinen, og vi har en god stemning på virksomheden, som er professionelt ledet.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet?

Vi tilbyder selvstændigt arbejde i moderne faciliteter. Det er et krav, at du er en erfaren smed, som har arbejdet inden for faget inden for de sidste par år. Du skal have tegningsforståelse, samt selv kunne udvikle og fremstille fiksturer og værktøjer til at sikre optimal håndtering af emner.

Vi forventer at du er en god kollega, som hjælper til når det er krævet af hensyn til teamet og opfyldelse af kunders forventninger. Du har humor og smil på læben i hverdagen, også når der er travlt. Bopæl nær Hasselager/Århus vil være en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav.

Interesseret?

Læs mere om virksomheden hjemmesiden www.iqmetal.com eller kontakt vores produktionsleder Lars Holm på telefon 8738 9036 for en uforpligtende og fuldt fortrolig snak. Ansøg ved at sende dit CV eller skriv lidt om din erfaring på: lh@iqmetal.com.

jobs.title: Bogholder / accountant: Vil du have styr på tallene hos en virksomhed i grøn vækst?
jobs.description:
(English below)

Hos SteamGreen ApS søger vi en struktureret og selvkørende bogholder, der vil tage ansvaret for vores daglige økonomifunktion. Hvad enten du leder efter en fuldtidsstilling eller ønsker fleksibiliteten ved en deltidsstilling (f.eks. 15–25 timer om ugen), skræddersyr vi gerne rammerne, så det passer til din hverdag.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Håndtering af fakturering, betalinger og rykkerprocedurer.

  • Lønadministration samt håndtering af refusioner.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har solid erfaring fra en lignende rolle som bogholder eller regnskabsansvarlig.

  • Du arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og sætter en ære i, at tingene stemmer til punkt og prikke.

  • Høj fleksibilitet: Mulighed for enten deltid eller fuldtid samt en fleksibel arbejdstid, hvor der også kan aftales delvis hjemmearbejde.

  • Uformelt arbejdsmiljø: Du bliver en del af et engageret og uformelt team med korte kommandoveje og højt til loftet.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer: Vi tilbyder en attraktiv lønpakke, der matcher dine erfaringer og kompetencer.

Ansøgning og kontakt Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til info@steamgreen.dk mærket "Bogholder".

______________________________________________________________________________________

ENGLISH

_______________________________________________________________________________________

Do you want to take charge of the numbers at a growing green company?

At SteamGreen ApS, we are looking for a structured and self-driven Bookkeeper to take responsibility for our daily financial operations. Whether you are looking for a full-time position or prefer the flexibility of a part-time role (e.g., 15–25 hours a week), we are happy to tailor the framework to fit your everyday life.

  • Daily bookkeeping, coding, and reconciliation of bank accounts, accounts receivable, and accounts payable.

  • You have solid experience from a similar role as a bookkeeper or accounting officer.

jobs.title: Kreditor- og administrationsassistent
jobs.description:
Har du styr på detaljerne – og trives du med en hverdag, hvor administration og økonomi går hånd i hånd?

Hos Kids-World søger vi en engageret og struktureret kreditor- og administrationsassistent til vores økonomiafdeling.

Stillingen kombinerer kreditorbogholderi, ejendomsadministration og øvrige administrative opgaver. Fælles for opgaverne er, at de kræver struktur, overblik og en god økonomisk forståelse.

Du bliver en del af en mindre økonomiafdeling, hvor du får et bredt ansvarsområde og sammen med dine kolleger er med til at sikre en effektiv og velfungerende økonomi- og administrationsfunktion på tværs af koncernens selskaber.

En væsentlig del af stillingen er den daglige håndtering af kreditorprocessen via digitale workflows. Du håndterer undtagelser, følger op på manglende godkendelser, sikrer korrekt kontering og momsbehandling samt afklarer eventuelle afvigelser i dialog med både leverandører og kolleger på tværs af organisationen.

Samtidig får du ansvaret for en række administrative opgaver inden for koncernens bolig- og erhvervsejendomme, herunder huslejeopkrævning, lejekontrakter og den løbende dialog med lejere, håndværkere og leverandører.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Registrering, kontering og betaling af kreditorfakturaer.

  • Løbende bogføringsopgaver og vedligeholdelse af bogholderiet for koncernens ejendomme.

  • Administration af en portefølje af bolig- og erhvervsejendomme.

  • Udarbejdelse og administration af lejekontrakter samt oprettelse af ejendomme og lejere i vores systemer.

  • Huslejeopkrævning, varsling og regulering af husleje samt opfølgning på restancer.

  • Udarbejdelse af forbrugsregnskaber samt administration af vand- og varmeregnskaber.

  • Løbende dialog og samarbejde med lejere, håndværkere, leverandører, viceværter og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

  • Vedligeholdelse af data og dokumentation i Business Central, Boligflow og øvrige administrative systemer.

  • Administrative og økonomiske ad hoc-opgaver på tværs af koncernens selskaber.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde i Business Central og Boligflow. Erfaring med et eller begge systemer er en fordel, men ikke en forudsætning. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære nyt og trives med digitale arbejdsprocesser – vi sørger naturligvis for en grundig oplæring.

 

 

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra en administrativ eller økonomisk funktion, hvor du har arbejdet med både administrative og regnskabsmæssige opgaver. Du behøver ikke være uddannet bogholder eller ejendomsadministrator, men du har en god forståelse for, hvordan administration og økonomi hænger sammen, og du motiveres af at få tingene til at fungere.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:

  • Trives med en hverdag, hvor nogle opgaver er faste rutiner, mens andre varierer.

  • Har en god økonomisk og regnskabsmæssig forståelse og arbejder sikkert med kreditorhåndtering, opkrævninger og afstemninger. Har du erfaring med moms, er det en fordel.

  • Trives med administrative opgaver og motiveres af at skabe orden og overblik.

  • Arbejder struktureret, omhyggeligt og har blik for detaljen.

  • Har let ved at skabe gode relationer og kommunikerer naturligt og professionelt med lejere, håndværkere, leverandører og kolleger.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, men trives samtidig i et mindre team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og følger dine opgaver helt til dørs.

  • Har flair for IT og lyst til at lære nye systemer. Erfaring med Business Central, Boligflow eller lignende systemer er en fordel, men ikke en forudsætning.

Hvorfor os?

Hos Kids-world er vi et team på 115 dedikerede medarbejdere, som alle brænder for at gøre en forskel. Vi værdsætter fleksibilitet, personlig udvikling og et arbejdsmiljø med højt til loftet. Hos os bliver du en del af en virksomhed i vækst, hvor din indsats gør en reel forskel – og vi sørger for, at der er plads til både seriøsitet og sjov i hverdagen!

Det Praktiske

Vi tilbyder en fast stilling på 30-37 timer ugentligt i vores afdeling Administration & Økonomi i vores domicil i Esbjerg. Vi har frokostordning, som du til en fordelagtig pris kan blive en del af. Kaffe/te samt frugt er også til fri afbenyttelse.

Du bliver ansat under HK’s overenskomst, med løn efter kvalifikationer og hos os får du bl.a. pensionsordning, fritvalgskonto, mulighed for sundhedsforsikring, 5 feriefridage samt mulighed for fordelagtige køb i shoppens varesortiment.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV, som du kan sende til jobs@kids-world.dk. Marker mailen med "Administration og økonomi".

For at sikre en god forventningsafstemning fra start, beder vi dig oplyse dit forventede lønniveau i din ansøgning. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, og opslaget vil blive fjernet, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Alle ansøgninger vil blive behandlet fortroligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Jannie Tofte på tlf: 32173575

jobs.description:
Are you an adventurous nature person and a tourism professional who thrives in the wilderness and would like to work in a responsible tourism pioneering company?

Look no further! Come to work with us in Harriniva.

CHEF

For our destinations Harriniva Adventure Resort and Jeris Lakeside Resort, we are looking for a chef with training and experience in the field, cheerfully skilled service expert who speaks English and has the necessary passports for the job. Your task is to prepare breakfast, lunch and dinner, as well as a la carte dishes.

To be able to succeed in the position you should have:

- Experience in kitchen work

- Enthusiastic and forward going set of mind in a seasonal position.

- Good interaction and cooperation skills, as well as a systematic and independent way of working

- Interest in growing with the position

- Good english skills


Are you ready to show what you got? jobs.title: Purchaser
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Purchaser to support successful project execution through procurement, commercial evaluation of supplier offers, supplier negotiations, proactive order follow-up and ensuring accurate purchasing data throughout the procurement process.

The preferred location for this position is Vaasa, Finland, but Helsinki may be considered for the right candidate. We offer the possibility of hybrid work.


Your role and responsibilities

As a Purchaser, you will support the successful execution of projects by ensuring timely and cost-effective procurement of materials and services. You will work closely with project teams, strategic purchasers, suppliers, logistics, engineering, and other key stakeholders to secure deliveries according to project requirements and schedules.

You will be joining a skilled and collaborative Procurement team where we support each other, take ownership of our work, and continuously look for ways to improve.


Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

* Reviewing purchase requisitions and evaluating supplier offers
* Creating and managing purchase orders
* Conducting supplier negotiations and commercial discussions
* Actively following up orders to secure on-time deliveries and accurate order confirmations
* Monitoring delivery performance and proactively addressing potential risks and delays
* Maintaining accurate purchasing, supplier, and delivery data in SAP
* Collaborating closely with project teams, strategic purchasers, logistics, and suppliers
* Contributing to continuous improvement of procurement processes and ways of working



To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

* Experience from a similar position with a proven track record
* Strong experience in supplier negotiations and commercial decision-making
* Commercial or technical education (B.Sc. or M.Sc.)
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience working with ERP systems, preferably SAP
* Good analytical skills, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining high-quality data
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic project environment
* Fluency in written and spoken English
* A proactive mindset and willingness to continuously learn and develop



Considered an advantage:

* Experience in project business, energy, or supply chain management
* Experience with Power BI, Logwis or similar business systems
* Experience with supplier performance follow-up and delivery management
* Finnish and/or Swedish language skills



Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility of our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.


Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

For any questions related to this position, please reach out to Anders Nyqvist, General Manager, Procurement, at +358 50 358 0196 on Thursday, August 6, from 12:00 to 14:00 EET (only for direct job applicants; applications sent by email will not be recorded or responded to).

Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!
